messages.content: 在考慮目前的增長率，日本在未來10年和印度在未來20年的預計人口增長將分別是多少？如果我們考慮日本的增長率為1.5％，印度的增長率為2.1％，這些預測會如何改變？

function.name: population_projections
function.description: Calculates the projected population growth based on the current growth rate. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

country.description: The country for which to calculate the population projection.

years.description: Number of years for the projection.

growth_rate.description: Optional parameter to specify the growth rate. Default is current growth rate. of 0.01 This is a float type value.

First scenario: "considering current growth rate" - but we don't know current growth rates; maybe default is 0.01? The function default growth_rate is 0.01. So first call with default. Then second scenario: growth_rate=0.015 for Japan, 0.021 for India.

We should call function twice per scenario? Actually we can call function separately for each country. But we might combine calls? The function expects one country at a time. But we need to provide arguments: country, years, optional growth_rate. We'll produce JSON calls accordingly.

Third call: population_projections({"country":"Japan","years":10,"growth_rate":0.015})
